events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury, 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable showman Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched 35 years on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly marked a shift in their sound.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980; he would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost a true musical visionary. John Lennon's legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: On this day, we celebrate the enduring legacy of David Bowie, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Bowie 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is still felt across generations.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd
angles.copy: Long live the King. Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his music still gets the hips shaking.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Page 83rd
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro of the riff, Jimmy Page. His work with Led Zeppelin redefined rock music.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic 'Maggie May' singer, Rod Stewart, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod 82nd
angles.copy: Eighty-two years young for Sir Rod Stewart. Still rocking, still got the voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs, real name Graham McPherson, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs 66th
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the one and only Suggs! The voice of Madness, still bringing the nutty sound.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young 71st
angles.copy: Seventy-one today for Paul Young. His smooth vocals were the soundtrack to many an 80s romance.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly 81st
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton. A true national treasure, still shining bright.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary 56th
angles.copy: Fifty-six today for the man behind so many hits, Gary Barlow. From boyband heartthrob to national treasure.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean 77th
angles.copy: Get out your dancing shoes! Billy Ocean turns 77 today, still bringing the good times with his timeless tracks.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring legends like The Beatles, Bob Dylan, and The Rolling Stones.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock royalty took their place in history at the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. A true who's who of legends.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen 55th
angles.copy: Happy 55th to Mark Owen! Still charming the nation after all these years with Take That.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic Rooftop Concert
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their impromptu rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil 76th
angles.copy: Seventy-six today for the one and only Phil Collins. From Genesis to solo stardom, a true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Hugh Grant 67th
angles.copy: Happy 67th to the king of charming awkwardness, Hugh Grant. Still making us laugh and swoon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT 46th
angles.copy: Forty-six today for JT! From boyband sensation to solo icon, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: David Jason 87th
angles.copy: Happy 87th to a true national treasure, Sir David Jason. What a legend.

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 years on
events.blurb: On this tragic day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper lost their lives in a plane crash, an event famously known as "The Day The Music Died."

angles.name: Music Died Tribute
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years since "The Day The Music Died." We remember Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley, known for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley 61st
angles.copy: Sixty-one today for Rick Astley! We're never gonna give him up.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary King of Reggae, Bob Marley, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley 82nd
angles.copy: Eighty-two today for the incomparable Bob Marley. His message of peace, love, and unity resonates louder than ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Carole King, known for her seminal album 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Carole King 85th
angles.copy: Happy 85th to the songwriting genius Carole King. Her timeless melodies continue to touch hearts worldwide.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston, 15 years on
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012; she would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: Whitney Tribute
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost the voice of a generation. Whitney Houston's incredible talent and legacy live on.

events.title: Take That's original split, 31 years ago
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, the original Take That announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: Thirty-one years since the day Take That broke up, sending shockwaves through pop music. Thankfully, they're back and better than ever!

events.title: Ali Campbell (UB40) turns 68
events.blurb: Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of reggae band UB40, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell 68th
angles.copy: Happy 68th to Ali Campbell, the iconic voice of UB40. Still spreading those good reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran 36th
angles.copy: Happy 36th to Suffolk's finest, Ed Sheeran! Still dominating the charts and selling out stadiums worldwide.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: We remember The Beatles' "quiet Beatle," George Harrison, who would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: George Harrison 84th
angles.copy: The "quiet Beatle" George Harrison would have been 84 today. His spiritual songs and incredible guitar work left an indelible mark.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary frontman of The Who, Roger Daltrey, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Roger Daltrey 83rd
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the iconic voice of The Who, Roger Daltrey. Still smashing it after all these years.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Nik Kershaw 69th
angles.copy: Sixty-nine today for Nik Kershaw! Still the 'Wouldn't It Be Good' hitmaker.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Martin 50th
angles.copy: Happy 50th to Coldplay's Chris Martin! Half a century old and still filling stadiums worldwide.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Rock icon Jon Bon Jovi, frontman of the band Bon Jovi, celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Bon Jovi 65th
angles.copy: Sixty-five today for the one and only Jon Bon Jovi! Still living on a prayer and rocking out.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: We remember the distinctive voice of Chris Rea, who would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Rea 76th
angles.copy: The legendary Chris Rea would have been 76 today. His smooth vocals and evocative lyrics left us with so many timeless tracks.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: We celebrate the life and legacy of Mary Wilson of The Supremes, who would have been 83 today.

angles.name: Mary Wilson 83rd
angles.copy: The iconic Mary Wilson of The Supremes would have been 83 today. Her incredible talent helped define the Motown sound.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk debut
events.blurb: On this day in 1983, Michael Jackson famously debuted the Moonwalk during his performance of "Billie Jean" at Motown 25.

angles.name: Moonwalk Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-four years ago, Michael Jackson changed dance forever with the Moonwalk. A truly iconic moment in music history.

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Pioneering electronic music artist Gary Numan, known for 'Are 'Friends' Electric?', celebrates his 69th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Numan 69th
angles.copy: Happy 69th to the electronic music pioneer Gary Numan. Still influencing artists decades later.
